evidence.title: Plate V: 黄花阵 Huanghua Zhen, the maze
evidence.excerpt_other: A-peu-près au centre du labyrinthe s'élève un édifice octogone établi sur un soubassement circulaire.
evidence.summary: Square, in a wood, inside a wall and then a river with rocks and flowers; small wooden bridges and gates. Octagon with arches on its large faces, windows on the small ones, cul-de-four dome with a small lantern, circular stair round the base. Apparently a throne inside. Small casino at the east entry.

evidence.title: Engraving 5: 黄花阵 Huanghua Zhen, the maze
evidence.excerpt_other: This was a maze or labyrinth with carved brick walls about shoulder high, surmounted by little slender conventional pines.
evidence.summary: A two-storey building at the back overlooks it. Round stairs in the centre to an octagonal pavilion where, says the old caretaker Lu, mechanical singing birds were kept (hearsay).
